== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ハイパーウェーブ・スキャン</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">場の自分の側に配備する。「探査部隊」が「感知」の影響を受けなくなる。敵が13枚以上の手札を持っている時に「探査部隊」を使用したなら、敵は通常の効果に加えて、手札の中の、カード名に「反乱軍」が含まれるすべてのカードをロストする。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">帝国軍は完全を期す場合、全スペクトル探知器、高感度エネルギーセンサー、クリスタル式重力場感知器、ハイパーウェーブ信号傍受装置等を総動員してスキャンを行う。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Hyperwave Scan]].

'''Lore''' — When the Empire wants a complete scan, it mobilizes full-spectrum detectors, high-sensitivity energy sensors, crystal gravfield sensors, hyperwave signal interceptors, and similar devices.

'''Game text''' — Deploy on your side of the table. Scanning Crew is no longer affected by Sense. If you use Scanning Crew when the opponent has 13 or more cards in hand, the opponent also loses every card in hand whose title contains Rebel.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Lore is a full scanning procedure rather than a device list. Game text names Scanning Crew 「探査部隊」 and Sense 「感知」, and loses hand cards whose title contains 「反乱軍」. The English face says immune to Sense and cards with Rebel in the title.<ref>[[:File:ANH-D-hyperwavescan.gif|Original English face]], [[Hyperwave Scan]].</ref>
